definitions.definition: $x_{1}$ is a ball/sphere/orb/globe [shape/form] of material $x_{2}$; $x_{1}$ is a spherical object [made of $x_{2}$].
$x_{1}$ reflects Russian empire/USSR/ex-USSR (Soviet]/CIS culture/nationality in aspect $x_{2}$.
$x_{1}$ (agent) expresses/says $x_{2}$ (sedu'u/text/lu'e concept) for audience $x_{3}$ via expressive medium $x_{4}$.
$x_1$ 是有着意义 $x_2$的词，从属于语言 $x_3$ (形容性：$x_1$ 是词)
$x_1$是$x_2$品种的香蕉/车前草（既指果实也指整株植物）
$x_1$（la'e zo BY/字母等）是字母/数字/符号，在字母表/符号集$x_2$中，代表/表征$x_3$

$x_1$ is a source language for Lojbanic gismu $x_2$, contributing word $x_3$ (zoi) to make it, which were adapted into the Lojban alphabet as $x_4$ (lo'u or zoi), the language having weight in the algorithm $x_5$ (li)

$x_1$ (lu; quote) is said/expressed by $x_2$, followed by expression $x_3$ (lu; quote), via expressive medium $x_4$, and then continuing on/proceeding/serially resuming to express/say $x_5$ (lu; quote), and then $x_6$ (lu; quote), and then $x_7$ (lu; quote), ... (open-ended terbri structure of arbitrarily many sumti slots).
$x_1$ (zoi quote) is $x_2$ moras/morae in 'weight' (default: 1) by standard $x_3$.
